sync-docs.title: Sync Docs
sync-docs.description: Pre-PR step: review strad's documentation against the branch diff and update whatever has gone stale — README.md, AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, docs/, HACKS.md, strad.config.example.yaml — so docs ship in the same PR and never drift from code. Default, always-on: run it as the final routine before opening a PR. Vendored copy of the central Reframe sync-docs skill, adapted to strad's documentation surface.

strad-deploy-staging.title: Deploy strad to Staging
strad-deploy-staging.description: Deploy a strad change to the staging environment. The `Deploy staging` workflow deploys a published image tag (ghcr.io/tadasant/strad:<version>, default latest) to the strad-staging App Platform app rendered from infra/strad.staging.yaml, so the normal path is a merge to main (which builds the image and then deploys it); a manual workflow_dispatch either re-pins staging to an existing tag (rollback) or, with build:true, builds the dispatched BRANCH into branch-scoped core and bundle images and deploys those. Covers dispatching the run, deploying an unmerged branch and restoring main, the App-Platform full-replace hazard, verifying the public 401-gated host, rollback, and what an agent session can and cannot do without DO/GCP credentials. Production is NOT deployed from this repo — it lives in tadasant-internal.
